title: Art Deco
look: Gold on black: a symmetric sunburst fan, stepped arcs, pinstripes and metallic edges.

doc.essence: A 1920s lobby panel: lacquer black, gold inlay, a rising fan of rays and stepped arcs, every line ruled and every shape mirrored.
doc.notIt: Not gilded (black lacquer and machine geometry, no vellum, no diaper), not neon (solid black parts edged in metal, no glow), not stained glass (no colour, no lead).
doc.shapes: No dark outline: every part is edged with a thin gold line, like inlay set into lacquer.
doc.colour: Bodies are black lacquer with fine gold pinstripes; bellies cream; accents, props and lines polished gold.
doc.eyes: Pale gold, so they shine out of the black.
pitfalls: A black body on a black page relies on the gold edge: never drop it.
The fan must stay symmetric about the character's centre.
